name: marimekko
title: Marimekko plot
description: Columns by group with widths proportional to record count, divided vertically by status share.
needs: Records with groups; a numeric measure is optional for amounts.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: The width of each column shows volume for that group. The vertical split shows match results. A wide column with few breaks is healthy; a narrow column that is mostly breaks highlights disproportionate effort.
text.chartSub: Column width is {unit} count; the vertical axis is share of that group's {unit}. Select a column.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Column order: as sent, largest volume first, or most issues first.

options.name: initialGroup
options.description: Key of the group to select initially; defaults to the group with the most issues.
